dossier.public_summary: The apparent 14.7-day dip changes from ~9,000 ppm to ~25,000 ppm between two sectors and one of four transits is much shallower than the others, so the signal is not steady as a planet would be. The odd-even difference, borderline secondary, and large out-of-eclipse swing favor a blended binary or false alarm over a 5.3 Earth-radius planet.

reasons.why: Depth is not consistent across individual transits; one transit is ~5x shallower, inconsistent with a planet, but highly consistent with a few bad/outlying events creating the signal.
